errors: A background Pages suite reading (node --test over platform/pages) ran past 20 minutes on a cold card cache, competing for cores with the changepoint timings. It was killed and not used; the clean before/after numbers were taken after it stopped.

doc_friction.issue: Both perf backlog items (P063, P064) are still owner-gated workflow edits, as three earlier runs reported; step 1 is a dead end until the owner acts.

The cloud-session note says to start long suites with run_in_background, but a full local Pages suite on a cold share-card cache outlasts any useful wait. A note on its cold-cache duration would save a run from starting it as a side reading.

notes: Metric: wall time of changepoint-detector's engine.test.mjs and its 'count trend bends' test, node --test --test-reporter=spec, 4-core container, quiet, two runs each. Before (main a2add1f2c engine.mjs): test 16.19/16.00 s, file 36.84/36.33 s. After: test 14.00/13.90 s, file 34.27/33.98 s (-13% test, -7% file). Change: PELT scores the Poisson cost inline (same prefix sums and expression as makeCost), and robustSd is skipped for poisson/negbin/negbin1, which never read sigma. Same answers: pelt() deep-equal to main's on 10,800 random count cases; sha256 of 30 analyze() results unchanged; whole changepoint suite 768 tests, 0 failed (run_venture_tests.py, 237 s under contention). Pool reading (ci_profile --runs 600): 596.6 job-min over 1 h, Portfolio Pages 232.5, Portfolio validate 125.3, ventures tests 59.9. Before choosing this lever, 18 mid-size venture suites were timed: all under 7 s.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: profile, exact-equality harness, two timed runs and write-up for a senior engineer

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
